correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np
def solve(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); H,W=inp.shape
    fr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=0]
    fc=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(inp[:,c]))==1 and inp[0,c]!=0]
    sepc=int(inp[fr[0],0]) if fr else int(inp[0,fc[0]])
    sr=set(fr); sc_=set(fc_) if False else set(fc)
    sepv=np.zeros((H,W),bool)
    for r in sr: sepv[r,:]=True
    for c in sc_: sepv[:,c]=True
    from collections import defaultdict
    info=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not sepv[i,j] and inp[i,j]!=0 and inp[i,j]!=sepc:
                info[int(inp[i,j])].append((i,j))
    spec=max(info,key=lambda v:len(info[v]))
    rs=[a for a,_ in info[spec]]; cs=[b for _,b in info[spec]]
    r0=min(rs); c0=min(cs)
    stamp=np.zeros((max(rs)-r0+1,max(cs)-c0+1),int)
    for a,b in info[spec]: stamp[a-r0,b-c0]=1
    # band -> list of colors found in that band (any object)
    bands={}
    for v,cells in info.items():
        if v==spec: continue
        rb=sum(1 for s in fr if s<min(a for a,_ in cells))
        bands.setdefault(rb,set()).add(v)
    out=inp.copy()
    for i in range(H):
        if sepv[i,:].all() or (sepv[i,:] and inp[i,0]==sepc and True) or (i in sr): continue
        if i in sr: continue
        rb=sum(1 for s in fr if s<i)
        cols=bands.get(rb,set())
        if not cols: continue
        col=list(cols)[0]
        for da in range(stamp.shape[0]):
            for db in range(stamp.shape[1]):
                ii=i+( (len(sr)-sum(1 for s in sr if s>i)) ) -1 +0
        # bottom-aligned within band: band spans last row before next sep (or H-1)
        br=max([r for r in sr if r>i] or [i])
        for da in range(stamp.shape[0]):
            for db in range(stamp.shape[1]):
                ii=br-da; jj=c0_of_band(j)+db
                if ii>=0 and jj<W and not sepv[ii,jj]:
                    out[ii,jj]=col
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in out.tolist()]

import os,glob,re,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

inp=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); o1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
# Find the object per band: nonzero cells not on separator rows/cols within band
def bandobjs(inp):
    H,W=inp.shape; sepR=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(map(int,inp[r])))==1 and inp[r][0]!=0]
    sepC=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(map(int,inp[:,c])))==1 and inp[0,c]!=0]
    # split row ranges
    rr=[]; prev=0
    for s in sepR+[H]:
        if s>prev: rr.append((prev,s)); prev=s+1
    cc=[]; prev=0
    for s in sepC+[W]:
        if s>prev: cc.append((prev,s)); prev=s+1
    return rr,cc,sepR,sepC
rr,cc,_,_=bandobjs(inp)

def stamp_sets(name):
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    res=[]
    H,W=i.shape
    rr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(map(int,i[r])))==1 and i[r][0]!=0]
    cc=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(map(int,i[:,c])))==1 and i[0,c]!=0]
    # bounding boxes per band/block
    bands=[]; p=0
    for s in rr+[H]:
        if s>p: bands.append((p,s)); p=s+1
    blocks=[]; q=0
    for s in cc+[W]:
        if s>q: blocks.append((q,s)); q=s+1
    pat=None
    for br,(r0,r1) in enumerate(bands):
        ob=[bc[0] for bc in blocks if (i[r0:r1,bc[0]:bc[1]]!=0)&np.zeros_like(i[r0:r1,bc[0]:bc[1]],bool)]
        objs=[]
        for bc,(c0,c1) in enumerate(blocks):
            sub=i[r0:r1,c0:c1]
            nz=(sub!=0)&(sub!=i[rr[br],0])  # exclude separator color
            if nz.any():
                osub=o[r0:r1,c0:c1]
                painted=sub==0 & (osub!=0)
                cells=[(r,c) for r in range(sub.shape[0]) for c in range(sub.shape[1]) if painted[r,c]]
                objs.append(((r0+r_,c0+c_) for r_ ,c_ in [(0,0)]))
        objs.append(None)
    return bands,blocks

def get_pat(name):
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    H,W=i.shape
    rr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(map(int,i[r])))==1 and i[r][0]!=0]
    cc=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(map(int,i[:,c])))==1 and i[0,c]!=0]
    bands=[]; p=0
    for s in rr+[H]:
        if s>p: bands.append(p); p=s+1
    blocks=[]; q=0
    for s in cc+[W]:
        if s>q: blocks.append(q); q=s+1
    sepc=i[rr[0]][cc[0]] if False else None
    sepcol=set()
    for s in rr:
        for c in range(W):
            if i[s,c]==i[s,0] and i[s,0]!=0: sepcol.add(i[s,c])
    seen=set(); patterns={}
    for br in bands:
        for bc in blocks:
            cells=[(r,c) for r in range(br,br+4) for c in range(bc,bc+4) if i[r,c]!=0 and i[r,c] not in sepcol]
            if not cells: continue
            rel=[(r-br,c-bc) for r,c in cells]
            pat=frozenset(rel)
            # painted set in output: cells where out!=0, in-band region excluding orig object? include all nonzero out minus input nonzero
            opat=[(r,c) for r in range(br,br+4) for c in range(bc,bc+4) if o[r,c]!=0 and i[r,c]==0]
            orelen=[(r-br,c-bc) for r,c in opat]
            painted=frozenset(orelen)
            key=tuple(sorted(pat))
            if key in patterns and patterns[key]!=painted: print('CONFLICT'); break
            patterns[key]=painted
    return patterns

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,glob,re,json
def load3():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load3(); print(sorted(G))
